correctness.rationale: Exact Hermitian Herglotz positivity reduction, determinant identity, and principal-minor proof give the full operator-radius formula, including zero weights and all \(ho>0\). Fixed squared Hilbert–Schmidt mass reduces the optimizing geometry to monotonicity in the product of the two weights; the boundary and \(ho=2\) equality cases follow. Supplementary finite diagnostics are not the proof.

value.rationale: An exact complete smallest non-rank-one weighted-shift model resolves a natural sharp extremal question: below the classical numerical-radius parameter \(ho=2\) equal weights minimize at fixed Hilbert–Schmidt energy, whereas above it equal weights maximize. This is a structural optimizer phase reversal, not merely a restatement of the rank-one formula or large-radius asymptotic.
